name: Memory Dump
description: Windows MDM settings in the Memory Dump category, applied as OMA-URI (SyncML) values.

properties.name: Allow Crash Dump
properties.description:
This policy setting decides if crash dump collection on the machine is allowed or not.

Supported values:
0 - Disable crash dump collection.
1 (default) - Allow crash dump collection.

properties.name: Allow Live Dump
properties.description:
This policy setting decides if live dump collection on the machine is allowed or not.

Supported values:
0 - Disable live dump collection.
1 (default) - Allow live dump collection.
